title: Truth or Dare Generator - Safe, Simple Prompts
meta_description: Generate a light truth question or simple dare for a voluntary, general-audience group game.
intro: Pick one light truth question or low-risk dare from a built-in list.

sections.h2: How does the Truth or Dare generator work?
sections.content: Click Generate to receive either a truth or a dare. The prompt label tells you which type was selected.

sections.h2: How do we keep the game comfortable?
sections.content: Agree that anyone may pass, re-roll, or stop. Do not use a dare that risks injury, humiliation, property damage, or disclosure of private information.

sections.h2: Is this an adult Truth or Dare generator?
sections.content: No. The list is designed for a general audience and does not offer an adult category. Hosts should still review prompts for their particular group.

faq.question: Can I choose only truths or only dares?
faq.answer: No. The current tool selects from one mixed list.

faq.question: Can players skip a prompt?
faq.answer: Yes. Passing should always be allowed.

faq.question: Are the dares checked for every situation?
faq.answer: No. Use your judgment and skip any prompt that is unsafe or inappropriate in your setting.
